name: QuestRabbit Warren — Lobby & Job Board
folder: Franchise Wars — Act I: Employee of the Month
notes: S1 Onboarding at the Warren. Pip Ashworth, the job board, Contractor Agreement (Clause 77-B).

name: THAC0 Spell — Dining Room, Kitchen & Drive-Thru
folder: Franchise Wars — Act I: Employee of the Month
notes: S1 Lunch Rush / The Ingredient. Drive-Thru Row flagship, Hollis Quench. Stairs in the stockroom lead to the cellar.

name: THAC0 Spell — Cellar with Two Doors
folder: Franchise Wars — Act I: Employee of the Month
notes: S1 The Cellar with Two Doors. One wooden storage door; one iron door older than the foundations, warm to the touch (opens in S14).

name: Murder King — Grand Throne Restaurant
folder: Franchise Wars — Act I: Employee of the Month
notes: S2 The Grand Throne Restaurant on Coronation Square, with a drive-thru moat. Costume storage, Duckworth Pym's office.

name: Gideon Tumble's Flat
folder: Franchise Wars — Act I: Employee of the Month
notes: S2 Mortimer's Flat — the mascot performer's rented rooms: the notebook with the trademark deed and the Crier appointment.

name: Brandmere Crier — Newspaper Office
folder: Franchise Wars — Act I: Employee of the Month
notes: S2 The Newspaper Office. The Murder King costume attacks the reporter at midnight.

name: Gelatinous Cube — Canal Street Creamery & Freezer
folder: Franchise Wars — Act I: Employee of the Month
notes: S3 The Creamery. The walk-in freezer hums a lullaby; staff lockers hold contracts with the Retention Clause circled.

name: Brandmere Canals
folder: Franchise Wars — Act I: Employee of the Month
notes: S3 The Canals. Night tracking: slime trails, lost boots, and a boatman who saw a big wobbly box heading for the Sweet Covenant warehouse.

name: Sweet Covenant Warehouse — Vats, Catwalks & Cold Store
folder: Franchise Wars — Act I: Employee of the Month
notes: S3 The Sweet Covenant Warehouse. Handlers load Gelli onto a barge bound for the Deep Dairy.

name: Starkfucks — Silent Roastery
folder: Franchise Wars — Act I: Employee of the Month
notes: S4 The Silent Roastery. Cups float, stop, and lower. The chalk menu board reads 'WE ARE PEOPLE'.

name: Starkfucks — Back Office
folder: Franchise Wars — Act I: Employee of the Month
notes: S4 Meeting the Steward / The Back Office. Loyalty contracts in a warded filing cabinet; the strike headquarters of the Unseen Servant Collective.

name: Wight Castle — Graveyard Shift Restaurant
folder: Franchise Wars — Act I: Employee of the Month
notes: S5 Casing the Castle / The Graveyard Shift. The Old Gate Castle; after midnight the staff become ghosts reconciling receipts.

name: Crown & Cleaver Vault
folder: Franchise Wars — Act I: Employee of the Month
notes: S5 The Vault. A small undead vault beneath the Wight Castle kitchen; the crown on a velvet pillow; the C&C sigil on the crest.

name: Critical Wok — Noodle Bar & Kitchen
folder: Franchise Wars — Act II: The Franchise Wars
notes: S6 Critical Wok. Every customer rolls a d20 to order; the stolen spice is being cooked into Seventh Heaven Noodles in the back.

name: Probability Brands Group — Experimental Lab
folder: Franchise Wars — Act II: The Franchise Wars
notes: S6 The PBG Lab. Charts of queue length, luck-extraction readings, and a memo from Deuce Marchetti.

name: Brandmere City Chase — Rooftops, Alleys, Sewer & Carriage Road
folder: Franchise Wars — Act II: The Franchise Wars
notes: S7 The Chase. C&C cleaners on the rooftops, PHG stalkers in the alleys, a Hoard kobold ambush in the sewer, Team Deliverables in a hired carriage.

name: Tallow Lane & the Tankard & Tallow
folder: Franchise Wars — Act II: The Franchise Wars
notes: S8 Marda Hobb's tavern, unofficial HQ of the Last Independents. Act V war room.

name: Tallow Lane — The Siege (Street Battle)
folder: Franchise Wars — Act II: The Franchise Wars
notes: S8 The Siege of Tallow Lane. Little Caesars Legion attacks the Quarter: barricades, kegs and fire.

name: The Old Independents' Quarter
folder: Franchise Wars — Act II: The Franchise Wars
notes: S8 The List. Fourteen taverns, each with a proprietor and a reason to refuse. Tactical district map.

name: Five Wights — Reality-Glitch Kitchen
folder: Franchise Wars — Act II: The Franchise Wars
notes: S9 Reality Glitches. The fries flicker, customers repeat sentences, the brothers finish each other's sentences with Four's words.

name: CostCo-op — Executive Collateral Vault
folder: Franchise Wars — Act II: The Franchise Wars
notes: S9 The Executive Vault. Guarded by the dragons' kobolds and a Compliance Officer; Number Four dormant in a box.

name: Wand-Mart Supercentre
folder: Franchise Wars — Act II: The Franchise Wars
notes: S10 Rollback Day. Chaos, crowds, bargains — customers age a few days with each purchase.

name: Wand-Mart — Cash Office
folder: Franchise Wars — Act II: The Franchise Wars
notes: S10 The Cash Office heist. Doris Plank, unmoved, with the Folio on the desk — its entries rewrite themselves.

name: Drive-Thru Row
folder: Franchise Wars — Act II: The Franchise Wars
notes: Brandmere's fast-food strip: Murder King, THAC0 Spell, the Golden Orcs, Wight Castle, Owlbear Express and more — drive-thru lanes and car parks.

name: Pandemonium Bean Plantations
folder: Franchise Wars — Act III: Hostile Takeover
notes: S11 The Portal / The Plantations. Endless howling tunnels of glowing beans; each failed Wisdom save steals a memory.

name: Pandemonium — Overseer's Station & Harvester Pens
folder: Franchise Wars — Act III: Hostile Takeover
notes: S11 The Harvesters / The Overseer. A cambion on a howler; beyond him the processing shed where Compliance is packed for every ABI branch.

name: Temple of the Healing Hand
folder: Franchise Wars — Act III: Hostile Takeover
notes: S12 Temples in Crisis / The Shrine. Spells fizzle; a licensing booth outside sells HEALING™ by the prayer. Sister Wren keeps the shrine.

name: Goodberry's Head Office
folder: Franchise Wars — Act III: Hostile Takeover
notes: S12 The heist. Meditation rooms, juice bars, legal department, and a vault of trademarks — deeds to Healing, Sleep, Courage and Weekends.

name: Guild Arbitration Court — Trademark Hearing
folder: Franchise Wars — Act III: Hostile Takeover
notes: S12 The Trademark Hearing. Three arguments, three Persuasion checks: can Healing be owned?

name: Chick'n Familiar — Midnight Kitchen
folder: Franchise Wars — Act III: Hostile Takeover
notes: S13 The Midnight Invoice. A barbed devil collector arrives with a contract and a bucket; the first soul through the door after midnight.

name: Nine Circles Hospitality — Infernal Legal Floor
folder: Franchise Wars — Act III: Hostile Takeover
notes: S13 Counsel Ixabeth Vorr and the Due-Diligence Report: Hell has a competing jurisdiction claim.

name: The Franchise Below — The First Shop
folder: Franchise Wars — Act III: Hostile Takeover
notes: S14 The iron door opens onto stairs that go down for too long. A shop that is every shop; Dobbs serving customers who have waited centuries; the First Entry on the lectern.

name: Throne Tower — Boardroom & Throne Room
folder: Franchise Wars — Act III: Hostile Takeover
notes: S15 The Throne Tower. Aldric the Unkind on the top floor, eating executives, wearing the promotional crown.

name: The Revenant King's Crypt
folder: Franchise Wars — Act III: Hostile Takeover
notes: S15 Aldric's resting place beneath the Throne Tower — where the original Murder King was laid down and bought.

name: Long Rest Inn — Room 303
folder: Franchise Wars — Act IV: Market Domination
notes: S16 The Room. A door with a sign, a century of dust, and a time-stop field. Four heroes asleep inside.

name: The Sleepers' Dream
folder: Franchise Wars — Act IV: Market Domination
notes: S16 The Sleepers. The shared dream of the Last Five-Star Party: islands of memory adrift in the dark.

name: The Third Place — Grey Café
folder: Franchise Wars — Act IV: Market Domination
notes: S17 The Grey Café. A café that goes on forever; tables of lost things arranged by acquisition date. Concepts in soft voices.

name: The Third Place — Construction Site / Unfinished Reality
folder: Franchise Wars — Act IV: Market Domination
notes: S17 ABI's crews build a Starkfucks around a pillar of concepts. Combat on scaffolding over nothing; the site office Folio.

name: The Crawling City
folder: Franchise Wars — Act IV: Market Domination
notes: S18 Every Sweet Covenant shop is leaking: gelato oozes toward the canals, donuts roll, blizzards crawl, the glazed city watch swing swords.

name: The Glamoured Farm
folder: Franchise Wars — Act IV: Market Domination
notes: S18 The Dairy Quean farm's glamour is failing; the farmhouse flickers into a sinkhole. Auntie Curdle guards the way down.

name: The Deep Dairy — Mother Culture Vat Chamber
folder: Franchise Wars — Act IV: Market Domination
notes: S18 A cavern of vats the size of lakes, filled with living cream that shows faces. Granny Quean at the heart; the Mother rises.

name: The Crucible — Hoard Syndicate Dragon Boardroom
folder: Franchise Wars — Act IV: Market Domination
notes: S19 Executive Membership. The CostCo-op warehouse cleared of aisles; Robert's Rules of Order among apex predators; catering by the party.

name: Counting House — Reception & Infinite Office Floors
folder: Franchise Wars — Act IV: Market Domination
notes: S20 Reception: a Pip from a Ledger-page gives directions. The lift stops at Acquisitions, Collateral and Human Resources.

name: Counting House — Boardroom
folder: Franchise Wars — Act IV: Market Domination
notes: S20/S23 The Boardroom. Every director present or by proxy — Ulth'Arabica in a tank, SKÜ as a table that breathes, the Mother Culture's chair dripping. Reuse for the Extraordinary General Meeting.

name: Golden Orcs — Brandmere Grand Tusks
folder: Franchise Wars — Act V: The Final Acquisition
notes: S21 In the heart of the city. Kobold tunnels emerge beneath the sign — or the party fights through Little Caesars Legion lines. The tusk is a golden iron golem when disturbed.

name: Golden Orcs — Summit Tusks at Tollgate Pass
folder: Franchise Wars — Act V: The Final Acquisition
notes: S21 A mountain branch in a blizzard. Dragons who voted with the party can carry them here in minutes.

name: Golden Orcs — Drowned Tusks
folder: Franchise Wars — Act V: The Final Acquisition
notes: S21 Beneath the harbour. Codfather water breathing; Cornelius Gaff's ghost guides them; drowned accountants still clock in.

name: The Last Slice — Four-Leg Planar Delivery Route
folder: Franchise Wars — Act V: The Final Acquisition
notes: S22 Brandmere, the Third Place, Pandemonium, Avernus — four linked legs of Rook's foreseen delivery, joined by thresholds.

name: Avernus — Delivery Point & Infernal Toll Booth
folder: Franchise Wars — Act V: The Final Acquisition
notes: S22 Leg Three. Duke Vellichor's territory: a devil roadblock, an infernal toll booth, and Ixabeth Vorr's injunction.

name: Counting House — Signing Room
folder: Franchise Wars — Act V: The Final Acquisition
notes: S24 A small room. A desk. The Grand Ledger, bound in grey, open to a blank page. Tallis Vend offers tea.

name: The Whole Counting House — Infinite Filing-Cabinet Final Battle
folder: Franchise Wars — Act V: The Final Acquisition
notes: S24 The Chairman Fights. The room becomes the whole Counting House: every filing cabinet a weapon, every Compliance Officer a hand.

name: The Codfather — The Harbour Fry
notes: Brandmere docks. Don Pescatore Brine takes meetings in the back, beneath a painting of his grandmother holding a harpoon.

name: Kobold's Fried Chicken — Sunset Ward Bucket Shop
notes: Kobold head cook Skritch Twice-Fried is writing a strongly worded letter to the dragon.

name: The Colonel's Familiar — The Officers' Mess
notes: Tallow Lane. Colonel Ambrose Crane (evoker) and his familiar Major Pecksworth run it like a campaign.

name: Baskin Liches — Necropolis Parade
notes: Scoopmaster Hollowell, a very courteous skeleton with a scoop fused to one hand. 31 flavours, forever.

name: Dairy Quean — Frost Lane Parlour
notes: Granny Quean herself serves the Sunday rush in a pinafore. Treat yourself; we'll treat you back.

name: Dungeon Donuts — Watchhouse Corner
notes: Managed by Duty Sergeant Maple, retired guard and full-time fryer. The city watch's favourite.

name: Krispy Kobold — Market Ward Bakery
notes: Tikka Glaze-Snout dreams of opening a café that sells tea and nothing else. Hot. Now. Everywhere.

name: Dough & Beholder — The Only Shop
notes: Old Independents' Quarter. Xoribble lives above it in a round flat; the stair goes up from the back.

name: Inn-N-Out — Crossroads on the Great Road
notes: Managed by Reliable Josef, a dwarf who has never once been late. Adventurers in, adventurers out.

name: McGuffin's — Plotline Plaza
notes: Run by Serena Foreshaw, Narrative Integration Manager. You didn't know you needed it.

name: Big McGuffin's — The Midnight Plotline
notes: Run by Maxim Knell, who narrates his own actions under his breath. The jukebox plays ominous strings.

name: Owlbear Express — Food Court Flagship
notes: Ma Lin Tsao raised Hootsworth from an egg. Big portions. Bigger claws.

name: Dragon Express — Corporate Row
notes: Run by Vessk, a dragonborn chef who has personally been breathed on by all five. Five colours, one hunger.

name: Wok & Roll Initiative — Songbird Quarter
notes: Run by Jin Stagecraft, a retired rock bard with one lute string left. Everybody wok the dinosaur.

name: Saving Throw Subs — Temple Ward
notes: Run by Deacon Hobb, Marda Hobb's cousin, who sold his tavern to PBG and regrets it.

name: Hero's Roll — Guildhall Square
notes: Managed by Sir Crustin Leaf, a retired paladin who swore an oath to fresh bread.

name: Roll for Sandwich — Gamblers' Row Stall
notes: Dicey Jen's stall: d4 starter, d6 filling, d8 bread, d20 deluxe.

name: Sub-Class — The Silver Arcade
notes: Head chef Anselm Grue, who once cried over a pickle. Specialise your hunger.

name: The Footlong Rest — The Waystation
notes: On the Great Road, run by Mother Hessa (half-orc), who tucks everyone in. Eat. Sleep. Repeat.

name: Critical Rolls — Harbour Market
notes: Sushi for adventurers, with a tank of live things at the back.

name: Roll Initiative! — Crucible Arena Diner
notes: Grand Chef Ivo Bladesworth, a gladiator who retired to cooking and did not change his personality.

name: Natural Twenty Pieces — Adventurers' Row
notes: Run by Barnaby Fowl, who used to be an adventurer until he rolled a 1. Twenty pieces. Zero fumbles.

name: Cockatrice & Chips — Stonewall Row
notes: Run by Big Tam Grudge, a stone giant's grandson with a huge heart and a small shop. Freshly petrified.

name: The Rusty Bucket — Ironmonger Lane
notes: Fried food. Fixed armour. Fast. Grimbal Oakshank has feelings about the rust monsters.

name: Goodberry's — Greenmarket Flagship Grocery
notes: Bramble Sunwhistle (firbolg) is genuinely lovely and deeply underpaid. Feel good. Be good. Buy good.

name: Whole Foods & Components — Heights Market
notes: Tansy Oakes-Whitlow will tell you where every egg was born. Ethically sourced. Arcanely priced.

name: Trader Djinn's — The Portside Market
notes: Managed by Mister Hamza Bright, a genasi. Wonders from everywhere. Limit three.

name: Seven-Eleven Hells — The Old Gate Store
notes: Del has been working the till continuously for seventy-three years. Open all hours. Unable to close.

name: Circle K of Protection — The Crossways Branch
notes: Sister Maud Circlet thinks she's working for a church. Safe inside. Mostly.

name: Quickling Mart — The Fairgate Store
notes: Managed by Zip-Zip Nettleblur, who speaks thirty words a second. In. Out. Before you notice.

name: Potion Hut — Brewer's Row
notes: Managed by Oliver Crust, an alchemist. Now with stuffed crust elixirs.

name: Quest Buy — Market Ward Megastore
notes: Store Manager Blix, gnome. Everything an adventurer needs. Probably.

name: Target Acquired — The Heights Store
notes: Department Head Vera Bullock. We see what you need.

name: CostCo-op — Warehouse District Depot
notes: Membership Manager Hal Grundy. The warehouse store proper; free samples of the Mother Culture.

name: IKEA Mimic — Warehouse District Superstore
notes: Store Manager Björn Flatt has never been seen leaving. Showroom maze, warehouse and collection area; some assembly may consume you.

name: Papa Lich's — Papa's Original
notes: Necropolis Parade, staffed by skeletons in aprons and a head chef zombie called Gino.

name: Dominoancy — Tower Ward Kitchen
notes: Madame Olive Aspire foresees everything except her own divorce. We knew you'd order.

name: Little Caesars Legion — Camp Brandmere
notes: Commanded by Centurion Marcus Crustus, who treats pizza as a supply line and the city as a front.

name: Pizza the Hutt — The Palace-Restaurant
notes: The one and only palace-restaurant, in the Warehouse District. We always collect.

name: The Crusty Dragon — The Hillside Oven
notes: Run by Matteo Scorch, a human with no eyebrows. Wood-fired. Dragon-fired.

name: Ale & Error — Tinkers' Row
notes: Head brewer Petronella Fizzwick, gnome, eyebrows regrown twice. Mistakes were made.

name: Critical Pint — Arena Street Bar
notes: Burt Gauntlet, ex-gladiator, never lost a trivia night. Drink like you rolled a twenty.

name: The Tipsy Mimic — Driftwood Quarter
notes: Old Moss Crabtree has not sat down in fifteen years. Sit anywhere. Carefully.

name: Barbarian's Barrel — The Northgate Barrel
notes: Hrothga the Mild, founder, has renounced violence. Rage responsibly.

name: T.G.I. Fireballs — Market Ward Grill
notes: Tamsin Blaze, tiefling, has sung happy birthday 40,000 times. Thank gods it's Fireball.

name: Hoots & Owlbears — Great Road Grill
notes: Candy Plume runs the 'ethical mascot initiative'. Feathers. Fur. Fun.

name: Hard Bard Café — Songbird Quarter
notes: Tony Riffs claims to have met every bard on the wall. Authentically legendary.

name: Bard to the Bone — The Deadbeat Room
notes: Managed by Skully Marrow, a skeleton with a mohawk. Loud. Dead. Forever.

name: NecroBucks — The Graveside Café
notes: Run by Countess Mira Dusk, a vampire barista. Brewed for eternity.

name: Costa Fortune — Exchange Street
notes: Madam Evangeline Coin can tell your income from your shoes. Coffee at a price.

name: The Daily Grindstone — Factory Gate Stall
notes: Run by Fen Oilyhand, who never sleeps. Coffee for the rest of us.

name: Bean There, Summoned That — Magus Ward
notes: Magister Pim Oddroast, conjurer. Your order, from anywhere — and the PHG portal to Pandemonium.

name: Espresso Patronum — College Ward
notes: Bea Hollowleaf remembers every student's name. Brew your best self.

name: Long Rest Inn — Great Road Inn (Ground Floor & Rooms)
notes: Innkeeper Gregory Latch, cheerful and sleepless. Eight hours guaranteed. Room 303 is upstairs (separate map).

name: Best Western Marches — The Frontier House
notes: Ruth Callow, cartographer. Where the map ends, we begin.

name: Plane Inn — The Crossroads Plane Inn
notes: Tariq Gatewright has checked in every kind of guest. Stay anywhere. Stay everywhere.

name: Bed, Breakfast & Beholders — The Heights
notes: The only B&B&B, run by Madam Ossifer, a beholder. Stay with us. We're watching.

name: Air B&B&E — Featured Listing (Mixed Rentals)
notes: Everywhere, via crystal. Entire dungeon, private crypt, shared wizard tower, goblin-friendly accommodation.

name: Brandmere Alley, Service Yard & Loading Bay
notes: Pest control, loss prevention, ambushes behind any franchise.

name: Commercial High Street & Market Square
notes: Generic shopfronts, stalls and a square — street brawls, sales-day chaos, chases.

name: Rooftop Network
notes: Walkable rooftops, gaps and chimneys — cat-burglary, courier interceptions, chases.

name: Sewer & Drain Tunnels
notes: Kobold ambushes, smuggling, the things that live under Drive-Thru Row.

name: Harbour Docks & Warehouse Apron
notes: Smuggled spice, Codfather business, barge interceptions.

name: Country Road & Caravan Route
notes: Deliveries, executive protection, highwaymen and rival contractors on the Great Road.

name: Forest, Grove & Monster Habitat
notes: Owlbear wrangling, ingredient foraging, ethical-mascot recoveries.

name: Cave & Mine System
notes: Procurement runs, kobold tunnels, dragonroot harvesting, rust-monster dens.

name: Ruined Dungeon & Basement Complex
notes: Haunted stockrooms, hostile acquisitions of old properties, anything under a franchise.

name: Graveyard & Generic Crypt
notes: Necropolis Parade deliveries, undead staffing disputes, mascot exhumations.

name: Independent Tavern (Generic)
notes: Any of the fourteen Tallow Lane holdouts — negotiations, brawls, quiet handshakes.

name: Noble Manor & Estate
notes: Executive protection, discreet repossessions, galas with a corporate guest list.

name: Temple & Shrine (Generic)
notes: Licensing disputes, blessing deliveries, divine trademark inspections.

name: Generic Corporate Office & Laboratory Floor
notes: Competitive research, audits, employee wellness inspections, sabotage.

name: Planar Portal & Transit Depot
notes: PHG logistics, Plane Inn transfers, cross-planar deliveries and customs inspections.
